independentARecord.observedScientificMeaning: The two hazard-to-control pairs are correct orientation examples: closed goggles cover the eyes for splash protection, and the vapor source belongs inside the fume hood. The standalone vapor flask is a hazard pictogram, with no actor inhaling or manipulating it. The hood sash leaves a lower working aperture, and inward arrows indicate containment rather than vapor release into the room. No universal glove rule, fabricated hazard label, flame or respirator substitution appears.
independentARecord.geometryProportionsUnitsAndLabels: Goggle frames enclose both eyes and remain separate from the face; the lab coat and tied hair are coherent. Flask, hood aperture and lowered sash fit spatially. Arrows in the hood are schematic capture indicators, not a quantitative ventilation diagram.
independentARecord.actualResponsiveInspection: At 360×203 the large splash, goggled face, flask and fume hood remain distinct. Gefahr → Schutz, Spritzer, Schutzbrille, Dämpfe and Abzug are readable; no tiny safety qualification carries the meaning. At 680×383 all objects, directions and umlauts remain clear.
independentARecord.actorFacingNotesAndInstruments: The only visible actor wears enclosed goggles with tied hair. There are no notes or instruments being read from a reversed actor perspective.
independentARecord.styleAndAgeFit: Friendly abstract school chemistry cartoon with coherent navy outlines, cream/blue backgrounds and lilac accents. Clear objects, appropriate Sek-I age fit and visual continuity with the two preserved parent JPEG overviews. No visible logo, technical ID, protected character or watermark.
independentARecord.altTextAssessment: The candidate alt text matches the visible central objects and relevant scientific distinction; it provides a meaningful non-visual description.
independentARecord.scopeLimits: The image illustrates two hazard-matched measures; it does not replace a substance hazard assessment, workplace instruction or the complete protective measures required by the specific activity.

independentBRecord.subject: chemie
independentBRecord.chatGptReviewer: Codex genuine independent machine reviewer B / chem_b007_six_child_images_independent_b
independentBRecord.chatGptNotes: Inaktiver sechs-B007-Kinderbildkandidat, genuine independent reviewer B. Tatsächliche Original-PNG und Browseransichten bei Original/360/680 sowie beide KEEP-Eltern-JPEGs betrachtet. Die zwei Gefahr-Schutz-Paare sind nachvollziehbar: Spritzer führen zur geschlossenen Schutzbrille, Dämpfe zum Abzug. Der große freie Kolben links im rechten Feld ist das Gefahrensymbol vor dem Zuordnungspfeil; die eigentliche Schutzdarstellung zeigt den kleineren Kolben im Abzug hinter dem teilweise abgesenkten Schieber. Die inneren Pfeile weisen in den Abzug. Es ist keine Person an einem offenen gefährlichen Arbeitsvorgang dargestellt. Keine Zahlenwerte, Mengen, chemischen Formeln oder Maßstäbe behauptet. Der Maßstabwechsel beim Kolben gehört zur symbolischen Gefahr-Schutz-Zuordnung. Alle vier Schlüsselwörter und die Gefahr-Schutz-Richtung sind in den tatsächlichen 360- und 680-Pixel-Browserbildern lesbar. Brillenumfassung, Schieber und der Kolben im Abzug bleiben als wesentliche Motive erkennbar. Schutzbrille liegt schlüssig über Augen und Nasenbrücke; kein Richtungsfehler an einem benutzten Instrument oder gelesenen Blatt. V-only; keine aktuellen D/P/A/M/SOURCE-/Seiten-/Kontext-/Karten-/M7- oder menschlichen Freigaben.

wholeGoal.title: Vorgegebene Entsorgungswege begründet auswählen
wholeGoal.titleEn: Select specified waste routes with reasons
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann für einen eindeutig bestimmten Chemikalienrest anhand seiner Eigenschaften und einer örtlichen Entsorgungsanweisung den vorgesehenen Sammelweg begründet auswählen und fehlende entscheidungsrelevante Angaben benennen.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: For an identified chemical residue, the learner can select the specified collection route using its properties and a local disposal instruction, and identify missing information needed for a decision.

resourceLinks.title: Visualisierung: Vorgegebene Entsorgungswege begründet auswählen

independentARecord.observedScientificMeaning: The image selects the A route only for the identified Rest A under an explicit instruction. The separate question-mark bottle receives the instruction Erst klären and no disposal arrow. Capped containers and absence of pouring, mixing, drains or domestic bins avoid an unsafe universal disposal rule. The selected route is local and symbolic rather than a claim that any chemical of a physical state shares one waste class.
independentARecord.geometryProportionsUnitsAndLabels: The wall instruction maps Rest A to Behälter A and depicts a single A collection container; the foreground Rest A bottle and separate unknown bottle are physically distinct. The teacher points to the route while the unknown remains unresolved.
independentARecord.actualResponsiveInspection: At 360×203 the A labels, route arrow, question mark and Erst klären remain readable; the teacher and learner retain their separation. At 680×383 the instruction and closed caps are unambiguous. Background glassware does not dominate the disposal decision.
independentARecord.actorFacingNotesAndInstruments: Both actors wear goggles. The instruction is on a wall panel available to them, not a paper facing away from its reader. The notebook has unlettered lines and no demonstrably reversed scientific notation.
independentARecord.styleAndAgeFit: Friendly abstract school chemistry cartoon with coherent navy outlines, cream/blue backgrounds and lilac accents. Clear objects, appropriate Sek-I age fit and visual continuity with the two preserved parent JPEG overviews. No visible logo, technical ID, protected character or watermark.
independentARecord.altTextAssessment: The candidate alt text matches the visible central objects and relevant scientific distinction; it provides a meaningful non-visual description.
independentARecord.scopeLimits: No concrete chemical properties or authorized disposal recipe are supplied; the diagram is a decision orientation and cannot authorize disposal without identifying the residue and applying the actual local instruction.

independentARecord.observedScientificMeaning: A supplied work instruction controls the sequence Messen → Rühren → Dokumentieren. Separate ordinary salt and water are followed by a visibly uniform, transparent liquid without bottom solid, layers or reaction bubbles. A glass stirring rod is inside the liquid and a final beaker observation is documented. No flame, tasting, drinking, improvised hazardous reaction or disappearance of matter is shown.
independentARecord.geometryProportionsUnitsAndLabels: The vessel and salt dish depict readiness rather than numerical measurement; no false graduations or invented quantities appear. The rod enters through the beaker opening and is gripped outside the vessel. The result sketch agrees with the homogeneous liquid shown in the stirring panel.
independentARecord.actualResponsiveInspection: At 360×203 all three actions, connecting arrows, salt/water symbols, rod and notebook remain recognizable. Messen, Rühren, Dokumentieren and Nach Arbeitsanweisung are readable. At 680×383 the hands, clear liquid and check marks are unambiguous.
independentARecord.actorFacingNotesAndInstruments: The notebook is viewed over the writer shoulder; its top, binding, sketch and pen are oriented toward the writer at the lower edge. The rod hand approaches from above and does not pass through the glass. Faces are omitted in this close-up and no claim about unseen eye protection is made.
independentARecord.styleAndAgeFit: Friendly abstract school chemistry cartoon with coherent navy outlines, cream/blue backgrounds and lilac accents. Clear objects, appropriate Sek-I age fit and visual continuity with the two preserved parent JPEG overviews. No visible logo, technical ID, protected character or watermark.
independentARecord.altTextAssessment: The candidate alt text matches the visible central objects and relevant scientific distinction; it provides a meaningful non-visual description.
independentARecord.scopeLimits: The ungraduated measuring-vessel icon is conceptual and does not teach accurate measurement or an actual recipe. Amounts, permitted materials, method and full documentation remain supplied by the working instruction and ordinary learning content.

Das rechte Heft ist aus der Perspektive über die Schulter des Schreibenden aufrecht orientiert, mit Hand und Stift am passenden Seitenrand. wholeGoal.title: Löslichkeit und Sättigung aus Daten erklären
wholeGoal.titleEn: Explain solubility and saturation from data
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann für einen vorgegebenen Stoff, ein Lösungsmittel und eine Temperatur aus Mengen- und Beobachtungsdaten erklären, ob eine Lösung gesättigt oder ungesättigt ist und welche zusätzliche Stoffmenge sich unter diesen Bedingungen noch lösen kann.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: For a specified substance, solvent and temperature, the learner can use quantities and observations to explain whether a solution is saturated or unsaturated and how much further solute can dissolve under those conditions.
